name: Core Scientific Muskogee data center campus
summary: Core Scientific high-density colocation campus at 1525 West 43rd Street South in Muskogee, Oklahoma, served by Oklahoma Gas & Electric. A 70 MW building designed for Nvidia GB300 systems is leased to CoreWeave and was billing by mid-July 2026, and a second building of about 82 MW, now leased to AMD, is under construction for delivery from the second half of 2027. In May 2026 Core Scientific announced plans to grow the campus to about 1.5 GW of gross power, about 1.0 GW leasable, on about 250 acres, and in August 2026 it closed the purchase of Polaris DS, which holds about 440 MW of in-service OG&E grid capacity.

location.note: Core Scientific gives the street address 1525 West 43rd Street South, Muskogee. No geocoder was used, so coordinates are the Muskogee city point from its Wikipedia article, which also names the county.

parties.name: CoreWeave
parties.note: Named as tenant of the roughly 70 MW first building only in the Q2 2026 earnings presentation (s4). The May 2026 release (s3) describes that leased building, designed for the Nvidia GB300 platform, without naming the customer.

parties.name: AMD
parties.note: Named for Muskogee only in the Q2 2026 earnings presentation (s4), which lists about 82 MW at this AMD direct site. The Q2 release (s8) gives the 15-year term for about 530 MW across five sites without naming them.

metrics.note: Gross utility power capacity from OG&E listed in the 10-K; the company site page also describes a 100 MW development with a substation able to support more than 500 MW.
Leased capacity reported as billing by mid-July 2026. Core Scientific does not say whether the figure is critical IT load.
Building under construction since at least May 2026, when it was described as an unleased 82.5 MW building; leased to AMD in July 2026.
In-service gross grid capacity held by Polaris DS LLC under electric service agreements with OG&E, acquired by Core Scientific to support the expansion.
Planned gross power from a mix of grid and behind-the-meter supply, which the company equates to about 1.0 GW of leasable power. Gross power is not defined as IT or facility load.
From the undated company site page, accessed 2026-10-09.
Described as secured to support the planned expansion; the sources do not say whether it is owned or held under option.

milestones.note: The 70 MW CoreWeave building was in final testing in May 2026 with delivery targeted for Q2 2026, and was billing by mid-July 2026.
Plan to scale the campus to about 1.5 GW of gross power and agreement to buy Polaris DS.
Core Scientific disclosed AMD leases including about 82 MW at Muskogee.
Acquisition of Polaris DS completed for about USD 444 million in cash.
Target for initial delivery of the roughly 82 MW AMD building; the May 2026 release gave Q4 2027.

power_sources.description: Grid power from Oklahoma Gas & Electric, including about 440 MW of in-service capacity under Polaris DS service agreements; load studies for more grid capacity were due to finish in 2026.
Core Scientific says it has a plan for a scalable behind-the-meter power solution to supplement grid supply, without naming the fuel or size.
